_meta.note: residual_scale is set IN CODE per-variant via dataclasses.replace(DEFAULT_CONFIG, residual_scale=X), NOT the env var, so two values can coexist in one process for paired head-to-heads.

HEUR_200_V27.cost: cheap (200 sims); computed in Phase-2 pass

ITER8_POLICY_ONLY_LEAF_V27.cost: one @200 neural search/position; computed in Phase-2 pass

ITER8_NO_RESIDUAL.cost: FREE — identical agent to ITER8_POLICY_ONLY_LEAF_V27 (the residual-0 wrapper discards net value)
